examples.text_en: They did not act indiscriminately but with great care.
examples.text_zh: 他们并没有不分青红皂白地行事，而是十分谨慎。

examples.text_en: The law should not be used indiscriminately against everyone.
examples.text_zh: 这项法律不应被不分青红皂白地用来对付每个人。

examples.text_en: Their indiscrimination between good and bad work brings real problems.
examples.text_zh: 他们对好坏工作不加区别，这带来了实实在在的问题。

examples.text_en: His indiscrimination about friends was a problem for the family.
examples.text_zh: 他对朋友不加区别，这给家人带来了麻烦。

examples.text_en: The indispensability of water is clear to everyone.
examples.text_zh: 水不可或缺，这一点大家都清楚。

examples.text_en: No one questions the indispensability of good friends in life.
examples.text_zh: 没有人怀疑好朋友在生活中的不可或缺。

examples.text_en: The young man tried to indite a song about love.
examples.text_zh: 那个年轻人试着创作一首关于爱情的歌。

examples.text_en: She will indite a short story for the school paper.
examples.text_zh: 她将为校报写一篇短篇故事。

examples.text_en: He values individualism more than group rules.
examples.text_zh: 他重视个人主义甚于群体规则。

examples.text_en: The book celebrates individualism and personal freedom.
examples.text_zh: 这本书赞美个人主义和个人自由。

examples.text_en: The group tried to indoctrinate young people with their ideas.
examples.text_zh: 那个团体试图用他们的思想向年轻人灌输。

examples.text_en: Schools should help children to think, not to indoctrinate them.
examples.text_zh: 学校应当帮助孩子思考，而不是向他们灌输。

examples.text_en: The indolent boy would not get out of bed.
examples.text_zh: 那个懒惰的男孩不愿起床。

examples.text_en: An indolent life brought him nothing but pain and loss.
examples.text_zh: 懒惰的生活给他带来的只有痛苦和损失。

examples.text_en: She showed an indomitable will to finish the race.
examples.text_zh: 她表现出跑完全程的不屈意志。

examples.text_en: His indomitable spirit helped the team keep going.
examples.text_zh: 他不屈不挠的精神帮助球队坚持下去。

examples.text_en: The fact is indubitable and no one can question it.
examples.text_zh: 这个事实是确凿无疑的，没有人能质疑。

examples.text_en: We have indubitable evidence that he was at home.
examples.text_zh: 我们有确实的证据证明他当时在家。

examples.text_en: This state is inducible by a change in the body.
examples.text_zh: 这种状态可由身体的变化所诱导。

examples.text_en: Some problems are inducible by the food we eat every day.
examples.text_zh: 有些问题是由我们每天吃的食物所诱发的。

examples.text_en: They will induct the new members at the meeting today.
examples.text_zh: 他们将在今天的会议上让新成员入会。

examples.text_en: The team will induct him into the group next week.
examples.text_zh: 团队将在下周接纳他加入这个小组。

examples.text_en: His induction into the group took place last month.
examples.text_zh: 他上个月正式加入了这个团体。

examples.text_en: The book shows induction with many simple examples.
examples.text_zh: 这本书用许多简单的例子说明归纳法。

examples.text_en: Parents should not always indulge their children's every wish.
examples.text_zh: 父母不应总是迁就孩子的每一个愿望。

examples.text_en: He likes to indulge in a long sleep on free days.
examples.text_zh: 在空闲的日子里，他喜欢纵情睡个长觉。

examples.text_en: Time can indurate the heart against pain and loss.
examples.text_zh: 时间能使人心变硬，不再感受痛苦与失去。

examples.text_en: The fire will indurate the earth into hard rock.
examples.text_zh: 大火会把泥土烧硬，变成坚硬的岩石。

examples.text_en: The country began to industrialize very quickly.
examples.text_zh: 这个国家开始迅速工业化。

examples.text_en: They hoped to industrialize the poor region.
examples.text_zh: 他们希望使这个贫穷地区实现工业化。

examples.text_en: The industrialized city became large over the last ten years.
examples.text_zh: 这座工业化的城市在过去十年间变得很大。

examples.text_en: Many industrialized countries face the same social problems.
examples.text_zh: 许多工业化国家面临着相同的社会问题。

examples.text_en: The inebriate man could not walk a straight line.
examples.text_zh: 那个醉酒的男人走不成直线。

examples.text_en: He was quite inebriated when he left the party.
examples.text_zh: 他离开聚会时已经醉得很厉害了。

examples.text_en: The beautiful night gave her an ineffable feeling.
examples.text_zh: 美丽的夜色给了她一种无法形容的感觉。

examples.text_en: There was an ineffable power in his simple words.
examples.text_zh: 他简单的话语里有一种不可言喻的力量。

examples.text_en: The war left an ineffaceable mark on the town.
examples.text_zh: 战争给这座小镇留下了无法磨灭的印记。

examples.text_en: Her kindness made an ineffaceable memory for him.
examples.text_zh: 她的善良给他留下了不可磨灭的记忆。

examples.text_en: His efforts to help were ineffectual and slow.
examples.text_zh: 他帮忙的努力既无效又缓慢。

examples.text_en: The medicine proved ineffectual against the pain.
examples.text_zh: 这种药对疼痛证明无效。

examples.text_en: The material is hard and quite inelastic.
examples.text_zh: 这种材料又硬又没什么弹性。

examples.text_en: Their rules are too inelastic for a changing world.
examples.text_zh: 他们的规则对变化的世界来说太不灵活。

examples.text_en: The inelasticity of the rope made it hard to tie.
examples.text_zh: 绳子缺乏弹性，很难打结。

examples.text_en: They blamed the inelasticity of the current system.
examples.text_zh: 他们把问题归咎于现行体制的僵化。

examples.text_en: He was ineligible for the team because of his age.
examples.text_zh: 由于年龄原因，他没有资格加入这支队伍。

examples.text_en: Such a young boy is ineligible to vote in this country.
examples.text_zh: 这么小的男孩在这个国家没有投票资格。

examples.text_en: Death is ineluctable and comes to every living thing.
examples.text_zh: 死亡不可避免，会降临到每一个活着的生命。

examples.text_en: They could not run from the ineluctable truth.
examples.text_zh: 他们无法逃避这个无法回避的事实。

examples.text_en: His inept handling of the case upset everyone.
examples.text_zh: 他对这案子笨拙的处理让大家都不满。

examples.text_en: She felt inept at fixing the small machine.
examples.text_zh: 她觉得自己修理这台小机器很笨拙。

examples.text_en: The loss was blamed on the manager's ineptitude.
examples.text_zh: 这次失败被归咎于经理的无能。

examples.text_en: Her ineptitude with money caused real trouble.
examples.text_zh: 她在金钱上的无能造成了真正的麻烦。

examples.text_en: The law did nothing to end the inequity in our society.
examples.text_zh: 法律没有采取任何措施来消除社会中的不公。

examples.text_en: Many people fought against the inequity of the system.
examples.text_zh: 许多人都起来反抗这个制度的不公平。

examples.text_en: The gas is inert and does not react.
examples.text_zh: 这种气体是惰性的，不会发生反应。

examples.text_en: He lay inert on the floor for a moment.
examples.text_zh: 他在地板上一动不动地躺了一会儿。

examples.text_en: The car kept moving forward because of its inertia.
examples.text_zh: 汽车由于惯性继续向前行驶。

examples.text_en: His inertia at work made the team lose many chances.
examples.text_zh: 他工作上的惰性让团队失去了许多机会。

examples.text_en: The child has an inexhaustible amount of energy.
examples.text_zh: 这孩子有用不完的精力。

examples.text_en: Her patience with students seemed inexhaustible.
examples.text_zh: 她对学生的耐心似乎无穷无尽。

examples.text_en: The inexorable rise of the sea could not be stopped.
examples.text_zh: 海水的无情上涨无法被阻止。

examples.text_en: Time is inexorable and waits for no one at all.
examples.text_zh: 时间是无情的，它谁都不会等待。

examples.text_en: They felt it inexpedient to change the plan now.
examples.text_zh: 他们觉得现在改变计划是不明智的。

examples.text_en: The manager called the move inexpedient and risky.
examples.text_zh: 经理称这一举措失策又有风险。

examples.text_en: He carried an inexpiable pain for the rest of his life.
examples.text_zh: 他余生都背负着无法抵偿的痛苦。

examples.text_en: The war left an inexpiable loss on both sides.
examples.text_zh: 这场战争给双方都留下了无法弥补的损失。

examples.text_en: The change in him was quite inexplicable to us.
examples.text_zh: 他身上发生的变化让我们十分不解。

examples.text_en: There was an inexplicable light over the dark sea.
examples.text_zh: 黑暗的海面上方有一道无法解释的光。

examples.text_en: Their lives were inextricably related from that day on.
examples.text_zh: 从那天起，他们的生活就紧紧地交织在一起，无法分开。

examples.text_en: The two problems were inextricably part of one big question.
examples.text_zh: 这两个问题无法分开，同属一个大问题。

examples.text_en: The infamous man was known all over the country.
examples.text_zh: 那个声名狼藉的男人在全国都很有名。

examples.text_en: That infamous day is still in the mind of the people.
examples.text_zh: 那个不光彩的日子仍然留在人们心中。

examples.text_en: His infantile behavior annoyed the other workers.
examples.text_zh: 他幼稚的行为让其他工人很恼火。

examples.text_en: The doctor studied the infantile disease with care.
examples.text_zh: 医生仔细研究了这种婴儿疾病。

examples.text_en: The infantry moved forward through the dark night.
examples.text_zh: 步兵在黑暗中向前推进。

examples.text_en: The infantry held the line until help could come.
examples.text_zh: 步兵守住了防线，直到援军能够赶来。

examples.text_en: Her voice seemed to infatuate every man in town.
examples.text_zh: 她的嗓音似乎让镇上的每个男人都着了迷。

examples.text_en: The young man let the game infatuate him for many weeks.
examples.text_zh: 这个年轻人让游戏迷住了他好几个星期。

examples.text_en: He was infatuated with her from the very first day.
examples.text_zh: 从第一天起，他就对她着了迷。

examples.text_en: The infatuated boy could think of nothing but her.
examples.text_zh: 那个痴迷的男孩满脑子想的都是她。

examples.text_en: His infatuation with her did not last very long.
examples.text_zh: 他对她的迷恋并没有持续多久。

examples.text_en: What he felt was only simple infatuation, not love.
examples.text_zh: 他所感受到的不过是单纯的迷恋，而不是爱。

examples.text_en: The virus can infect people through the air.
examples.text_zh: 这种病毒能通过空气传染给人。

examples.text_en: A small cut can infect if you ignore it.
examples.text_zh: 小小的伤口如果不管它就可能感染。

examples.text_en: His infelicitous words made her feel bad at the party.
examples.text_zh: 他在聚会上不得体的话让她很难过。

examples.text_en: It was an infelicitous time to ask for more money.
examples.text_zh: 这个时候再要钱是不合适的。

examples.text_en: The infelicity of his words caused some hurt.
examples.text_zh: 他措辞的不当造成了一些伤害。

examples.text_en: She apologized for the infelicity of the phrase.
examples.text_zh: 她为这个短语的不妥道了歉。

examples.text_en: From these facts we can infer that he was not there.
examples.text_zh: 从这些事实我们可以推断出他当时不在那里。

examples.text_en: You should not infer too much from one small thing.
examples.text_zh: 你不该从一件小事上推断太多。

examples.text_en: We made an inference from the facts we had.
examples.text_zh: 我们根据手头的事实做了一项推论。

examples.text_en: That inference seems too strong for the evidence.
examples.text_zh: 这个推论对现有证据来说似乎太过了。

examples.text_en: The night was full of an infernal light from below.
examples.text_zh: 夜里充满了从下方传来的地狱般的光。

examples.text_en: They felt lost in an infernal fire they could not stop.
examples.text_zh: 他们觉得自己迷失在无法扑灭的地狱之火中。

examples.text_en: The burning building became a real inferno.
examples.text_zh: 燃烧的大楼成了一片真正的地狱。

examples.text_en: They described the hot desert as an inferno.
examples.text_zh: 他们把炎热的沙漠形容成地狱。

examples.text_en: The infertile land gave the poor family nothing.
examples.text_zh: 这片贫瘠的土地无法养活这个贫穷的家庭。

examples.text_en: Nothing would live on that infertile earth and rock.
examples.text_zh: 在那片贫瘠的土地和岩石上，什么也活不了。

examples.text_en: Small insects can infest the kitchen at night.
examples.text_zh: 小虫子会在夜里大批滋扰厨房。

examples.text_en: The garden was infested with tiny green bugs.
examples.text_zh: 花园里爬满了绿色的小虫子。

examples.text_en: The sea seemed infinitely large to the young boy.
examples.text_zh: 对这个小男孩来说，大海似乎辽阔无边。

examples.text_en: She was infinitely better at the work than the rest.
examples.text_zh: 在这项工作上，她比其余的人强得多。

examples.text_en: The difference between the two was infinitesimal and easy to miss.
examples.text_zh: 两者之间的差别极小，很容易被忽略。

examples.text_en: Even an infinitesimal change in the plan could cause problems.
examples.text_zh: 即使是计划中极微小的变动也可能引发问题。

examples.text_en: The stars seemed to go on to infinity in the dark.
examples.text_zh: 星星在黑暗中似乎一直延伸到无限远。

examples.text_en: He loved her with a love that had no end, like infinity.
examples.text_zh: 他爱她，那份爱如无限一样没有尽头。

examples.text_en: The infirm man walked slowly down the road.
examples.text_zh: 这位虚弱的老人沿路慢慢走着。

examples.text_en: She stayed home to care for her infirm mother.
examples.text_zh: 她留在家照顾虚弱的母亲。

examples.text_en: His infirmity kept him from long walks.
examples.text_zh: 他的虚弱使他无法长时间行走。

examples.text_en: She hid her infirmity from the other workers.
examples.text_zh: 她向其他工人隐瞒了自己的病弱。

examples.text_en: His words could inflame the anger of the crowd.
examples.text_zh: 他的话可能激起人群的怒火。

examples.text_en: Such news may inflame feelings on both sides.
examples.text_zh: 这样的消息可能激化双方的敌意。

examples.text_en: The inflamed part on his hand was hot and red.
examples.text_zh: 他手上发炎的地方又热又红。

examples.text_en: Her inflamed hand made it hard for her to work.
examples.text_zh: 她发炎的手让她难以工作。

examples.text_en: The rules were inflexible and hard to change.
examples.text_zh: 这些规定很死板，难以更改。

examples.text_en: He was inflexible about the time of the meeting.
examples.text_zh: 他对会议时间毫不通融。

examples.text_en: People should not inflict their pain on those they love.
examples.text_zh: 人们不该把自己的痛苦施加在所爱的人身上。

examples.text_en: The war would inflict great loss on both sides.
examples.text_zh: 这场战争会给双方都带来巨大损失。

examples.text_en: The infliction of such pain was against the law.
examples.text_zh: 施加这样的痛苦是违法的。

examples.text_en: They saw the fine as a big infliction on the poor.
examples.text_zh: 他们把这笔罚款看作是对穷人的一种沉重惩罚。

examples.text_en: She missed a week of school with influenza.
examples.text_zh: 她因流感缺了一周的课。

examples.text_en: The influenza spread quickly through the small town.
examples.text_zh: 流感迅速传遍了这个小镇。

examples.text_en: The small town saw a great influx of new people.
examples.text_zh: 这个小镇涌入了大量新居民。

examples.text_en: The influx of money helped the school build a new room.
examples.text_zh: 这笔资金的流入帮助学校建了一个新房间。

examples.text_en: It was an informal meeting between friends and family.
examples.text_zh: 那是一次朋友和家人之间的非正式聚会。

examples.text_en: He likes the informal style of the small local group.
examples.text_zh: 他喜欢这个小型地方团体不拘礼节的风格。

examples.text_en: The informer gave the police the names of the group.
examples.text_zh: 线人把那个团体的名字交给了警方。

examples.text_en: No one in town would talk to the known informer.
examples.text_zh: 镇上没有人愿意和那个众所周知的告密者说话。

examples.text_en: You should not infringe the rights of other people.
examples.text_zh: 你不应侵犯他人的权利。

examples.text_en: The new law may infringe on our personal rights.
examples.text_zh: 这项新法律可能会侵犯我们的个人权利。

examples.text_en: The delay began to infuriate the waiting people.
examples.text_zh: 延误开始让等待的人们极为愤怒。

examples.text_en: His careless answer seemed to infuriate her.
examples.text_zh: 他草率的回答似乎激怒了她。

examples.text_en: The new workers brought a fresh infusion of energy.
examples.text_zh: 新员工带来了新注入的活力。

examples.text_en: She made an infusion of herbs for her mother.
examples.text_zh: 她为母亲泡了一剂草药。

examples.text_en: He ingeniously fixed the machine with simple tools.
examples.text_zh: 他巧妙地用简单工具修好了机器。

examples.text_en: She ingeniously turned the small room into a study.
examples.text_zh: 她巧妙地把这个小房间改成了书房。

examples.text_en: Her ingenuity solved the problem in a minute.
examples.text_zh: 她的心灵手巧一分钟就解决了问题。

examples.text_en: The design shows real ingenuity and careful thought.
examples.text_zh: 这个设计体现出真正的心灵手巧和周密思考。

examples.text_en: The ingenuous child told the truth about the broken cup.
examples.text_zh: 这个天真的孩子如实说出了杯子打碎的真相。

examples.text_en: His ingenuous words made everyone trust him at once.
examples.text_zh: 他坦诚的话语让每个人立刻就信任了他。

examples.text_en: The body must ingest water and food to stay well.
examples.text_zh: 身体必须摄取水和食物才能保持健康。

examples.text_en: Some people ingest too much food in their daily life.
examples.text_zh: 有些人日常饮食中吃了太多东西。

examples.text_en: The ingestion of bad water is a serious problem.
examples.text_zh: 摄入不干净的水会带来严重的问题。

examples.text_en: Good ingestion of food helps the body work all day.
examples.text_zh: 良好的进食有助于身体一整天运转。

examples.text_en: The habit was deeply ingrained in the family.
examples.text_zh: 这个习惯在这个家庭里根深蒂固。

examples.text_en: Such fears can be ingrained from early years.
examples.text_zh: 这样的恐惧可能从早年就根深蒂固。

examples.text_en: The ingrate forgot every kind act his friends did.
examples.text_zh: 这个忘恩负义的人忘记了朋友们做的每一件好事。

examples.text_en: No one wants to help such a bad ingrate again.
examples.text_zh: 没有人愿意再帮助这样一个忘恩负义的人。

examples.text_en: He tried to ingratiate himself with the new director.
examples.text_zh: 他设法讨好新来的主管。

examples.text_en: She would ingratiate herself with anyone who had power.
examples.text_zh: 她会讨好任何有权力的人。

examples.text_en: His ingratiating words did not win the trust of the group.
examples.text_zh: 他逢迎的话语并没有赢得团队的信任。

examples.text_en: The ingratiating man stood by everything she said.
examples.text_zh: 这个逢迎的人对她说的每件事都表示支持。

examples.text_en: The gate allows ingress to the small garden.
examples.text_zh: 这道门让人可以进入小花园。

examples.text_en: They blocked the ingress with a heavy stone.
examples.text_zh: 他们用一块重石堵住了入口。

examples.text_en: She used her inheritance to buy a house.
examples.text_zh: 她用遗产买了一套房子。

examples.text_en: The money came to him as a small inheritance.
examples.text_zh: 这笔钱作为一小份遗产留给了他。

examples.text_en: Such rules may inhibit the growth of new ideas.
examples.text_zh: 这样的规则可能抑制新思想的发展。

examples.text_en: He could not inhibit his feelings when he heard the news.
examples.text_zh: 听到这个消息时，他无法抑制自己的情绪。

examples.text_en: The new inhibitor helped stop the growth in the body.
examples.text_zh: 这种新的抑制剂有助于阻止体内的增长。

examples.text_en: They hope this inhibitor can work for many years.
examples.text_zh: 他们希望这种抑制剂能持续发挥作用很多年。

examples.text_en: The new law was inimical to the rights of the poor.
examples.text_zh: 这项新法律对穷人的权利有害。

examples.text_en: Such food can be inimical to the health of a child.
examples.text_zh: 这样的食物可能对孩子的健康有害。

examples.text_en: She has her own inimitable style of writing.
examples.text_zh: 她有自己独特的写作风格。

examples.text_en: His inimitable voice made the songs famous.
examples.text_zh: 他独特的嗓音让这些歌出名了。

examples.text_en: The iniquitous law hit the poor more than anyone.
examples.text_zh: 这项不公正的法律对穷人的打击最大。

examples.text_en: He fought against an iniquitous system all his life.
examples.text_zh: 他毕生都在反抗这个邪恶的制度。

examples.text_en: They fought against the iniquity of the law.
examples.text_zh: 他们与这项法律的不公作斗争。

examples.text_en: He spoke out against the iniquity of the rulers.
examples.text_zh: 他公开抨击统治者的不义。

examples.text_en: The initiate had to wait a full year for the meeting.
examples.text_zh: 这位新成员还得等整整一年才能参加集会。

examples.text_en: As a new initiate, he did not yet know the rules.
examples.text_zh: 作为新入会的人，他还不了解这些规则。

examples.text_en: The nurse will inject the medicine into his arm.
examples.text_zh: 护士会把药注射进他的手臂。

examples.text_en: They hope to inject new energy into the project.
examples.text_zh: 他们希望给这个项目注入新的活力。

examples.text_en: The judge issued an injunction to stop the work.
examples.text_zh: 法官发出禁令，要求停止这项工作。

examples.text_en: They ignored the injunction and kept building.
examples.text_zh: 他们无视禁令，继续施工。

examples.text_en: Too much of it can be injurious to the body.
examples.text_zh: 这种东西过多会对身体有害。

examples.text_en: His injurious words were a real attack on her name.
examples.text_zh: 他那些中伤的话是对她名声的真正攻击。

examples.text_en: The people could no longer take such injustice from the state.
examples.text_zh: 人民再也无法忍受来自国家的这种不公。

examples.text_en: She fought against the injustice done to the poor family.
examples.text_zh: 她为那个贫穷家庭所遭受的不公而抗争。

examples.text_en: She had no inkling of what he was about to do.
examples.text_zh: 她丝毫不知道他即将做什么。

examples.text_en: I had an inkling that something was not right at home.
examples.text_zh: 我隐隐觉得家里有点不对劲。

examples.text_en: The water came into the inlet from the open sea.
examples.text_zh: 海水从开阔的大海流入这个港湾。

examples.text_en: They found a safe inlet near the small town.
examples.text_zh: 他们在小镇附近找到了一个安全的港湾。

examples.text_en: She never told anyone her innermost thoughts and feelings.
examples.text_zh: 她从不向任何人吐露内心深处的想法和感受。

examples.text_en: The innermost room of the house was always kept closed.
examples.text_zh: 房子最深处的那个房间总是关着。

examples.text_en: The question seemed innocuous but it made him feel bad.
examples.text_zh: 这个问题看似无害，却让他很难受。

examples.text_en: It was an innocuous word that no one remembered later.
examples.text_zh: 那是一句无伤大雅的话，后来谁都不记得了。

examples.text_en: The company must innovate to stay at the top of the market.
examples.text_zh: 这家公司必须创新，才能保持在市场的顶端。

examples.text_en: Young people often want to innovate and change the world.
examples.text_zh: 年轻人常常想要创新并改变世界。

examples.text_en: The company is known for its bold innovation.
examples.text_zh: 这家公司以其大胆的创新闻名。

examples.text_en: This small innovation saved the team much time.
examples.text_zh: 这项小小的创新为团队节省了大量时间。

examples.text_en: His words were full of innuendo about her work.
examples.text_zh: 他的话里满是对她工作的暗讽。

examples.text_en: She did not like the innuendo in his last answer.
examples.text_zh: 她不喜欢他最后一个回答中的讥讽。

examples.text_en: They will inoculate the children on the same day.
examples.text_zh: 他们会在同一天给孩子们接种。

examples.text_en: The group hopes to inoculate everyone in the small town.
examples.text_zh: 这个团体希望为小镇上的每个人都接种。

examples.text_en: His inoffensive words made the meeting easy for everyone.
examples.text_zh: 他那些不冒犯人的话让会议对每个人来说都很轻松。

examples.text_en: She found an inoffensive way to tell him the bad news.
examples.text_zh: 她找到一种不冒犯人的方式告诉他这个坏消息。

examples.text_en: He spent an inordinate amount of time on it.
examples.text_zh: 他在这件事上花了过多的时间。

examples.text_en: She has an inordinate love of sweet food.
examples.text_zh: 她过分喜爱甜食。

examples.text_en: The rock is inorganic and has no life in it.
examples.text_zh: 岩石是无机的，里面没有生命。

examples.text_en: They studied the inorganic part of the earth and sea.
examples.text_zh: 他们研究了地球和海洋中的无机部分。
